backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Vitalist Water backend, defining data types and storage for users, stores, and orders, with role-based access control via MixinAuthorization and AccessControl modules, plus CRUD operations for profiles, stores, and orders.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (auth, store management, order creation, QR workflow, etc.) to their corresponding source files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON object containing one-line summaries of key frontend source files, serving as a quick reference for what each component or page does.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark modes, plus base body and border styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the Vitalist Water React SPA, setting the page title, favicon, and mounting the React app via the /src/main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app in AuthProvider and renders role-specific pages (admin, staff, delivery) inside a Layout shell based on the authenticated user's role and current navigation state.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/StatCa: Reusable stat card component that displays a labeled count with a Lucide icon, supporting seven color themes for use in dashboard summary grids.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppSideba: Sidebar navigation component that filters nav items by the current user's role (admin/staff/delivery) and highlights the active page, displaying the Vitalist brand, a role badge, and a footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Layout.ts: Main app layout component with a collapsible sidebar, top header bar showing current user info and logout button, and a main content area with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/orders/StatusBad: Small presentational component that renders a styled pill badge displaying an order status with an icon and color derived from utility functions.
frontend/src/components/qr/QRCodeDisplay: Displays a QR code image for a given order ID using a generated URL, with a text fallback if the image fails to load.
frontend/src/components/qr/QRScanModal.t: Modal dialog that activates the device camera to scan QR codes, decodes the result into an order ID, and calls back with it on success.
frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx: Provides authentication context with hardcoded demo credentials for admin/staff/delivery roles, persisting session in sessionStorage and exposing login/logout functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags for use throughout the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping all backend actor calls for stores, orders, and users, covering CRUD operations with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for a water-blue themed design system including light/dark mode variables, status badge styles, and utility component classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin page for viewing, filtering, approving, and cancelling all orders, with QR code generation on approval and a detail dialog for individual orders.
frontend/src/pages/admin/QRManagementPag: Admin page that displays a searchable grid of QR codes for all approved (non-cancelled) orders, with summary stats for total, active, and completed QR codes.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ReportsPage.tsx: Admin analytics page showing order summary stats (today/week/month/total), status breakdowns, and top stores by order count using bar chart visualizations.
frontend/src/pages/admin/StoreManagement: Admin CRUD page for managing stores, supporting add/edit/delete operations with a form that includes GPS-based location detection.
frontend/src/pages/admin/UserManagementP: Admin CRUD page for managing users with roles (admin, staff, delivery), supporting add/edit/delete with password hashing and role assignment.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page that fetches all orders and displays aggregated statistics (today's orders, pending, ready, out for delivery, delivered) via StatCards plus a recent orders table with status badges.
frontend/src/pages/delivery/DeliveryDash: Delivery dashboard page that lists active dispatched/out-for-delivery orders, allows QR scanning to advance order status (Dispatched → Out for Delivery → Delivered), and shows GPS-based distance and navigation links for each order.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page with email/password form, show/hide password toggle, error display, and quick-fill buttons for demo admin/staff/delivery credentials.
frontend/src/pages/ScanPage.tsx: QR scan page supporting three role-based scanning stages (admin: Approved→Ready, staff: Ready→Dispatched, delivery: Dispatched→Out for Delivery→Delivered) with optional GPS capture and order status updates.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings page displaying the current user's account info (name, email, role), system information (app name, version, platform), and a sign-out button.
frontend/src/pages/staff/OrderCreationPa: Staff page with a form to create new water delivery orders by selecting a store, entering quantity/rate/notes, generating an order ID and invoice number, and submitting to the backend with a success banner on completion.
frontend/src/utils/geoUtils.ts: Utility module providing geolocation helpers: Haversine distance calculation, distance formatting, a promise-based wrapper for the browser Geolocation API, and a Google Maps URL builder.
frontend/src/utils/orderUtils.ts: Utility module for order data management, including parsing/building embedded JSON metadata in order notes, generating sequential order IDs and invoice numbers, encoding/decoding QR data, and providing status color/icon mappings.
frontend/src/utils/qrGenerator.ts: Utility that generates QR code image URLs by encoding order data in base64 and delegating rendering to the qrserver.com external API.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both standard query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback for persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that sets up dark mode, custom font families, an extended color palette using OKLCH CSS variables (including ocean, aqua, sidebar, and chart colors), and registers typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the full project state for the Vitalist Water Order & Delivery Management System, including feature list, architectural constraints, known issues, and image requirements. Tracks versioned features covering auth, store management, order creation, delivery workflow, QR scanning, invoicing, and reporting.
